// External callback effects unresolved: strict compilation must fail closed.
// A Future carrying Panics<InvariantError> may not be awaited in an unannotated caller.
// Supervised actor's panic cannot be locally consumed; deliver one CONTROL receipt.
// Even inside direct defer, recover must not consume panic.
fnc main(): int panics InvariantError { panic new InvariantError(); }
